# hpe_opsramp_custom_event_alert_source (Data Source)

Looks up an available alert source by name for CUSTOM-EVENT integrations. Returns its numeric ID for use in opsramp_integration resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the alert source to look up (e.g. 'Alien Vault').

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the alert source.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the alert source.
- `tech_uid` (String) The technical UID of the alert source (e.g. ALIENVAULT).
